text:
ops-bot: INCIDENT P1: routing/fallback misroute causing EU traffic to spill into us-west (pager duty: @Ashwin Patel) :rotating_light:
ops-bot: Impact: ~12% of EU requests routed to us-west model pool for last 8m, increased latency from 120ms->420ms for affected requests, some client 5xxs observed.
ops-bot: Channel created: #incidents (auto). Please ack and join.
Ashwin Patel: Acked, I'm on it. grabbing logs now. Paging backup oncall @Sophie Chen.
Maria Gomez: I'm standing by for customer impact summary / comms.
Sophie Chen: On call — jumping in. Quick question: any active deploys in routing service in last 30m?
Dmitri Ivanov: No deploys on routing service, but a canary of fallback-selection landed 40m ago (feature flag rollout 10%). Rolling back now.
Ashwin Patel: Timeline so far:
- 1783456550 ~ 10:22:30 UTC: minor spike in cross-region latency observed on infra dashboard.
- 1783456653 ~ 10:24:13 UTC: first 5xx from SSO customers reported.
- 1783456789 ~ 10:26:29 UTC: ops-bot auto-paged.
- 1783456800 ~ 10:26:40 UTC: mitigation 1 initiated: disabled fallback flag for canary (Dmitri).
- 1783456885 ~ 10:28:05 UTC: traffic still spilled; investigating routing table mismatch.
- 1783457001 ~ 10:30:01 UTC: temporarily added strict-region filter at ingress (Sophie).
Sophie Chen: Current hypothesis list (ranked):
1) Fallback selection logic incorrectly mapped EU region -> us-west pool when cache miss occurred (edge-case for multi-tenant tier mapping).
2) Autoscaling cold start + caching TTL mismatch caused routing to prefer fallback that was only registered in us-west.
3) Misapplied rollout rule for experimental tier-fallback policy (10% canary) that matched broader requests than intended.
Ashwin Patel: Sharing logs (snip):
```
[10:26:27.483] routing-service INFO match_request region=eu tenant=acme tier=standard selection=fallback_model variant=us-west-quantized reason="cache_miss"
[10:26:27.485] kv-cache WARN miss_key tenant=acme key=route:v2:eu
[10:26:27.487] selection-service DEBUG candidate_list=[eu-gptq, us-west-gptq] heuristic_score=[0.6,0.62]
[10:26:27.488] selection-service INFO selected=us-west-gptq rule_source=policy-rollout-2026-03-15
```
Maria Gomez: Customer impact snapshot: 8 customers flagged initial errors (SSO, billing webhooks). Affected transactions: ~3.2k requests in 8m window. Priority customers (enterprise) seeing elevated latencies.
Sophie Chen: Immediate mitigations taken:
- rolled back canary rollout (Dmitri)
- disabled experimental fallback selection service (Ashwin)
- applied strict region binding at ingress for EU (Sophie)
- increased KV cache TTL temporarily to avoid rapid cache misses (ops-bot command)
Dmitri Ivanov: After rollback, spillover reduced to ~1.1% within 2m, latency trending down. Full mitigation pending audit of rollout rule.
Ashwin Patel: Tests: running synthetic traffic from eu to validate region binding. Results: 1000 reqs => 0 misroutes after strict-region filter.
Support-Bot: Noted customer incidents: ticket #CUST-8921, #CUST-8922, #CUST-8923 created automatically and linked to thread.
Maria Gomez: Drafting customer msg: "We're investigating an internal routing issue affecting some EU traffic. Immediate mitigations applied; we'll follow up with RCA and timeline." Will propose to legal for enterprise customers.
Sophie Chen: Logging the hypotheses in thread for postmortem: add root-cause candidates and who owns probing.
Ashwin Patel: Probing items assigned:
- Dmitri: Audit rollout config + history (assigned)
- Sophie: Ingress region-binding delta + test harness (assigned)
- Maria: Customer comms + severity mapping + support coordination (assigned)
- Ashwin: Selection-service scoring thresholds + KV cache assumptions (assigned)
ops-bot: NOTE: please add findings to /confluence/incidents/1783456789-routing-handoff when ready.
Dmitri Ivanov: Found a config diff: policy-rollout-2026-03-15 had a missing clause `region == request.region || region == 'global'` and also a predicate that matched `tier == experimental || tier == standard` — that explains broader match. Saving diff and pushing to audit.
Ashwin Patel: Reproduction snippet for CI (run from eu):
```bash
curl -H "X-Region: eu" -H "Authorization: Bearer test-token" \
  https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gptq","tenant":"acme"}'
# observe selection-service logs showing selected=us-west-gptq on cache miss
```
Sophie Chen: Notes for RCA timeline: include KV cache TTL config change earlier today (ops infra tweak at 09:50 UTC) — scheduling postmortem to correlate.
Maria Gomez: Customer comms plan: initial notify sent, follow-up with timeline + impacted tenants list once postmortem draft ready. Legal and CSM looped.
Ashwin Patel: Post-incident checklist:
- confirm rollback of policy-rollout-2026-03-15 (done)
- audit canary targeting rules (in progress)
- add stricter unit tests for region predicate (todo)
- surface selection decision trace in proxy logs (todo)
Sophie Chen: Anyone see residual errors in monitoring? I still see a small uptick in 504 for EU edge at 10:40.
Dmitri Ivanov: that's the tail of in-flight requests re-routing. Should drop by 10:45.
ops-bot: Scheduled follow-up call 10:50 UTC in #incidents for RCA scoping.
Ashwin Patel: I'll own the in-thread RCA doc skeleton. Assigning follow-ups and ETA for draft: 24h.
Maria Gomez: Adding a communication flag for enterprise tenants; CSMs notified.
Support-Bot: Linked tickets updated with latest thread summary.
Sophie Chen: TL;DR for handoff to next oncall (if needed): rollback completed, strict-region filter active, monitoring alerts silenced but continue watch for 1h. Contact list: Ashwin, Dmitri, Maria.
Dmitri Ivanov: Uploading config diff to thread in 2m.
Ashwin Patel: Thanks team — great triage. Leaving a short note for the postmortem: potential root cause = overly permissive rollout predicate combined with cache miss path selecting fallback without region constraint.
Maria Gomez: Copy. I'll prepare customer-facing timeline once you all confirm final state.
ops-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Please move to postmortem workflow when ready.
